gate_type: IMPLEMENTATION gate — Canonical Same-Session Rich ASSY 2D Experience (R2)
objective: Restore the accepted rich TIPA ASSY experience (six-sub-line Frame A overview + Frame B 2D physical line with moving WIP, station/WIP inspector, quality/genealogy read models) on top of the SAME canonical TIPA RuntimeSession accepted in R1. The /assy-demo route must obtain that session through the same WorkspaceMonitor / G23 registry-backed live-session store used by /workspaces (no private cache, no second session/federation/runtime construction, no legacy DemoController instantiation on the product path). Frame A must project exactly ASSY-SL01..ASSY-SL06 from the canonical federation; Frame B must render the accepted 2D SVG from detached snapshots whose positions[] come from the canonical AssyLineRuntime public read surface; sub-line selection is presentation context only; STEP/RESET must delegate to the canonical RuntimeSession lifecycle so the shell and rich UI observe the same run/time; scenario/profile stays pinned run input (no legacy scenario-mutate-and-reset semantics); R3-only observation/MES endpoints must fail closed as explicitly deferred instead of spinning up legacy runtime truth. Preserve the existing rich visual design; minimal binding/identity adaptations only.
explicit_non_objectives: No second simulation runtime/controller/session for the rich UI
required_deliverables: src/virtual_factory/ui/assy_experience.py (same-session rich ASSY projection/experience adapter; no legacy controller)
src/virtual_factory/ui/api.py (/assy-demo endpoints served by the canonical experience; R3-only + unbindable legacy endpoints fail closed as deferred)
src/virtual_factory/ui/static/assy_demo.js + minimal HTML/CSS binding/identity adaptation (no visual redesign, no on-load reset)
forbidden_actions: Instantiate legacy DemoController/AssyDemoComposition as the /assy-demo active authority
Create a second RuntimeSession/federation/runtime for the rich UI
Step AssyLineRuntime directly from API/UI code
stop_conditions: Rich UI cannot be bound without creating a second RuntimeSession/runtime
Preserving a UI function requires legacy controller authority
Scenario switching requires generic lifecycle redesign
The existing 2D renderer cannot consume canonical detached snapshots without a major redesign
Implementation would materially change R1 domain semantics
